nom: The INKEY List Oat Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report the balm is gentle and does not irritate or break them out, but one reviewer had a strong reaction, itching and burning with bright redness, after the second use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report it removes makeup without stripping and leaves skin soft and hydrated.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin, whose skin gets drier in colder months, reports it removes makeup and SPF thoroughly without leaving skin dry.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin reports it feels gentle and nourishing, leaving skin refreshed rather than tight or dry.

concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or reactive skin broadly report the balm removes makeup and buildup without triggering breakouts, and one reviewer says it noticeably reduced facial inflammation.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report it leaves skin soft and hydrated rather than stripped, even after removing waterproof makeup or sunscreen.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, including several with sensitive or reactive skin, but one reviewer had a strong reaction, itching, burning, bright redness and flaky, crusty patches, after the second use and had to stop.

aspects.libelle: Formula can separate or leak from the tube
Melts stubborn waterproof makeup and SPF easily
Harder to squeeze out as the tube empties
Rich balm texture that emulsifies into a milky rinse

gifted by theinkeylist complimentary from theinkeylist I really wanted to love this cleanser because the first time I used it, everything seemed fine. My skin felt clean and soft with no issues. Unfortunately, after the second use, my face became extremely itchy and started burning. My skin turned bright red, and over the next day it became very dry and even developed flaky, crusty patches. I had to stop using it immediately. I'm sure it works for some people, but it definitely didn't agree with my skin.

I've been really impressed with the refreshed Oat Cleansing Balm. It melts away makeup, SPF, and daily buildup effortlessly, even stubborn waterproof products, without leaving any greasy residue behind. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and comfortable after cleansing—never tight or stripped. The fragrance-free formula is especially great for sensitive skin, leaving my complexion feeling calm, clean, and nourished (complimentary from theinkeylist)

I honestly wasn't expecting to love this as much as I do. I've tried so many cleansing balms and most of them either leave my skin feeling tight or they just don't actually remove my makeup properly (especially waterproof stuff) This one does! The texture is so satisfying to work with. It melts into the skin immediately and you can feel it just dissolving everything: foundation, mascara, SPF. I timed it the first time I used it and it genuinely does break down my makeup in seconds. No dragging, no rubbing my eyes 10 times trying to get mascara off. My skin is combination and tends to get drier in colder months, so I'm always nervous about cleansers stripping me. This one leaves my skin feeling so soft afterward. Like, soft in a way where I actually go and touch my face after rinsing because it surprises me every time. The fragrance-free formula is a huge plus for me too. I have pretty reactive skin and I was half expecting a breakout the first week (nothing happened, zero irritation). I haven't tried the original version so I can't compare, but if this is the "improved" formula I can only imagine the upgrade is significant. This is now a permanent part of my routine, morning and night. Highly recommend if you've been on the fence about balm cleansers, this one will convert you! gifted by theinkeylist

gifted by theinkeylist While I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review, I've been really impressed with the results. My skin has been glowing since I started using it. I have somewhat reactive, acne-prone skin, so finding a cleanser that effectively cleans without leaving my skin feeling dry or stripped is important. This cleanser does an excellent job of removing impurities while still maintaining my skin's natural moisture balance. One minor challenge is that I tend to keep my cleansers in the shower, and this formula is designed to be applied to dry skin with dry hands before adding water to emulsify. That can be a little inconvenient when showering, but it's not a dealbreaker. Overall, I've had a great experience with this cleanser and will definitely continue using it.

I've been using the new The INKEY List Oat Cleansing Balm for a few weeks, and it has quickly become a staple in my evening routine. It effortlessly melts away my makeup and sunscreen without needing to tug or rub my skin. The texture feels rich and comforting, yet it leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and balanced. As someone with mature skin, I appreciate how gentle and nourishing it feels. After cleansing, my skin doesn't feel tight or dry—just refreshed, hydrated, and ready for the rest of my skincare routine. It's simple, effective, and does exactly what I need it to do. gifted by theinkeylist

Not only did this clean my face without stripping everything from my face, but it had a noticeable impact on the inflammation on my face! I cannot recommend this enough
